steps.text: This page lists everyone with access to the community and their role: administrator, manager or member. You can invite, change a role, or revoke access.
steps.title: The community's users

steps.text: This page lists the accounts attached to the community and their role. This is where you invite a manager, change a role or revoke access.
steps.title: The community's users

steps.text: Click "Invite a manager" to email an invitation to someone who will help run the community.
steps.title: Invite a manager

steps.text: Enter the email address of the person to invite. They will receive an invitation to join the community as a manager.
steps.title: Enter the email address

steps.text: Send the invitation: the person receives it by email.
steps.title: Send the invitation

steps.text: The "See pending invitations" button opens the list of invitations that have been sent but not yet accepted, both members and managers.
steps.title: See pending invitations

steps.text: Open the managers tab to see the pending invitations.
steps.title: Manager invitations

steps.text: The "Managers" tab gathers invitations that have been sent but not yet accepted. While an invitation is pending, you can cancel it from this list.
steps.title: Pending invitations

steps.text: Close the window when you are done.
steps.title: Close

steps.text: Search for the user whose role you want to change.
steps.title: Search a user

steps.text: The pencil next to a user opens the role editor. You can promote a member to manager, or set a manager back to a plain member.
steps.title: Change a role

steps.text: On the user's card, the "Edit role" button opens the role editor.
steps.title: Change a role

steps.text: Choose the new role from the list.
steps.title: Pick the role

steps.text: Pick the new role from the list, then click "Save". The change takes effect immediately.
steps.title: Save the role

steps.text: The user is now a member: their role tag has changed and the remove action is now available on their row.
steps.title: Role updated

steps.text: The user is now a member: their role tag has changed and the remove action is now available on their card.
steps.title: Role updated

steps.text: The red cross removes the user from the community right away — their access is revoked immediately, with no extra confirmation.
steps.title: Remove a user

steps.text: On the card, the "Delete" button removes the user from the community right away.
steps.title: Remove a user

steps.text: Searching for that email now returns nothing: the user no longer has access to the community.
steps.title: User removed
